title: Biological evaluations and general-LLM controls
scope: Main protein/biomedical task evaluations from the discussed papers; selected general-LLM control groups. Not an exhaustive census of biology or every paper ablation.
access_note: Official papers, dataset cards and repositories were browsed. Raw-data retrieval in the container failed DNS resolution; this is a source-linked catalog, not a downloaded benchmark mirror.

tasks.plain_question: Does the expressed protein remain soluble under the dataset's assay setting?
tasks.split_configuration: Preserve the official PEER solubility split; exact test size not re-established.
tasks.limitation: Not binding affinity, thermostability, or a guarantee of solubility under every laboratory condition.
tasks.access_status: Official entry point verified; raw data not downloaded

tasks.plain_question: Is the protein membrane-associated or in the non-membrane/soluble class?
tasks.split_configuration: Binary task; do not substitute the separate ten-compartment label set.
tasks.limitation: 'Soluble' in the localization labels is not the same endpoint as expression solubility in P01.
tasks.source_locator: BioT5+ G.2.2; ProtST Table 2 and Appendix B
tasks.access_status: Official entry point verified; raw data not downloaded

tasks.plain_question: Which cellular compartment does this protein belong to?

tasks.limitation: Location is a different question from molecular activity or binding specificity.
tasks.access_status: Official entry point verified; raw data not downloaded

tasks.plain_question: What effect does this amino-acid change have?
tasks.model_input: Reference and mutant sequences/change, plus model-specific protein context
tasks.model_output: A description of the mutation's effect
tasks.reference_evidence: Expert-source annotations, publication-enriched descriptions; synthetic reversals present in corpus
tasks.split_configuration: Random split then similarity tiers: Easy 460, Medium 384, Hard 404. Separate temporal test has 1,611 examples.
tasks.limitation: Similarity tiers do not make the entire split homology-disjoint. Judge output is not independent experimental verification.
tasks.access_status: Dataset/repository verified; HF viewer has mixed-schema casting issue; use actual files and official loader

tasks.limitation: Recovery of one annotated mutation is not the fraction of novel designs that work.
